history.body: Hi, I’m looking at a few properties around Seberang Jaya and wondering whether Pearl Residences could suit a first rental purchase. Could you give me a general idea of the unit options, pricing and what costs I should factor in?

For Pearl Residences Phase 1, the main unit type is Type A: 900 sq.ft., 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony.

For a price reference, a package snapshot dated 14 Aug 2026 shows Block 1B podium blocked, Levels 1–4, at a RM328,000 base. Applying the snapshot’s 8% category rebate gives about RM301,760 on that base only. That isn’t a confirmed current offer or an all-in SPA price; the latest package and exact unit configuration need checking. Parking premiums shown in the pricing materials vary by configuration (RM15k, RM20k or RM30k).

The maintenance fee is RM0.18 psf inclusive of sinking fund, so for 900 sq.ft. that’s about RM162/month. I’ll confirm a verified breakdown of other purchase costs, such as legal, stamp duty and financing charges, rather than guess. For your first rental purchase, are you mainly weighing monthly cash flow or longer-term value?
